name: tally error-statuses and write label-strict report sections
definition: count entries with the not-found status and write every required section label line exactly once with the specified formatting.
failure_mode: wrong status count or duplicated/misformatted labels fail the checks

name: translate neuron biophysics channel mechanisms into jaxley
definition: port gating/current models for the RGC channels from a NEURON-formatted specification into Jaxley channel classes and attach them to a loaded morphology.
failure_mode: missing or inaccurate channel parameters produce a trace that does not match the solution within tolerance

name: verify the fix end-to-end against the live rest upload endpoint
definition: Confirm via live HTTP requests that a traversal-typed upload is neutralized while the service remains reachable and functional.
failure_mode: The service is unreachable or still vulnerable, failing acceptance.

name: write a proto service and its request/response messages
definition: author a proto file declaring a service with two rpcs plus the message types they use
failure_mode: any rename or omission of service/rpc/message fails the text checks
